name.title: Name
name.description: The Compose service name: lower-case letters, digits, `-`, `_` and `.`, starting with a letter or a digit.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: `Deployment` keeps the container running (`restart: unless-stopped`). `Job` runs it once (`restart: "no"`).

args.title: Args
args.description: The command that replaces the image's default command, written as `command`. Empty keeps the image's command.

env_files.title: Env Files
env_files.description: Files of `NAME=value` lines that Docker Compose reads into the container's environment, written as `env_file`. A relative path is relative to the directory of the first Compose file. Put secrets here, so the rendered file does not contain them.

env.title: Env
env.description: Environment variables written into the file. A name here wins over the same name in `env_files`.

ports.title: Ports
ports.description: Ports the container listens on. Only a port with a `host_port` is published on the host.

health_check.description: How Docker Compose checks that the container is healthy. Null keeps the image's own `HEALTHCHECK`.

depends_on.title: Depends On
depends_on.description: The services that must reach a condition before this one starts.

service.title: Service
service.description: A service this one waits for: another component in the request or, when `placement` is `merge`, one of `existing_services`.

condition.title: Condition
condition.description: What Docker Compose waits for: `service_started` (the container has started), `service_healthy` (its health check passes) or `service_completed_successfully` (it has exited with status 0, as a `Job` does).

name.title: Name
name.description: The variable's name: a letter or `_`, then letters, digits or `_`. The planner reports any other name as an issue.

value.title: Value
value.description: Its value. The file quotes it, escapes its control characters and line breaks, and writes each `$` as `$$`, so Docker Compose passes the value to the container unchanged.

command.title: Command
command.description: The check as a program and its arguments, run without a shell (`CMD`). Give this or `shell`, not both.

shell.title: Shell
shell.description: The check as one command line, run by the container's shell (`CMD-SHELL`). Give this or `command`, not both.

interval_seconds.title: Interval Seconds
interval_seconds.description: Seconds between two checks. From 1 to 9223372036, the longest duration Docker Compose reads.

timeout_seconds.title: Timeout Seconds
timeout_seconds.description: Seconds one check may take before it counts as failed. From 1 to 9223372036.

retries.title: Retries
retries.description: Failed checks in a row after which the container is unhealthy. At least 1.

start_period_seconds.title: Start Period Seconds
start_period_seconds.description: Seconds after the container starts during which a failed check does not count. From 0 to 9223372036.

service.title: Service
service.description: The component the issue is about, or null for an issue with the whole request.

code.title: Code
code.description: What is wrong. The `dagentsc manifest compile` reference explains each code.

value.title: Value
value.description: The name or number the issue is about, as a string, or null when the code needs none.

placement.title: Placement
placement.description: `own`: the file is a whole Compose project. `merge`: the file is passed with `-f` after the files of the project that runs `existing_services`, so its services can depend on them.

network.title: Network
network.description: The network every service joins. `default` is the project's default network. The name follows the rule for service names.

external_network.title: External Network
external_network.description: True when `network` exists already and the file only joins it; give its full Docker name, such as `healthcare-demo_default`. False declares the network in the file.

existing_services.title: Existing Services
existing_services.description: The services the project already runs. A component may not take one of these names. With `merge`, a component may depend on them; with `own`, such a dependency is an issue.

components.title: Components
components.description: The services to render, in the order the file lists them.

services.title: Services
services.description: The name of every component, in request order, including the ones with issues.

issues.title: Issues
issues.description: Every reason the request cannot become a Compose file, in a fixed order. Empty when the file is rendered.

compose_yaml.title: Compose Yaml
compose_yaml.description: The Compose file, with no newline at the end, or null when `issues` is not empty. Docker Compose reads it with `-f`.

container_port.title: Container Port
container_port.description: The port the container listens on, from 1 to 65535.

host_port.title: Host Port
host_port.description: The port on the host that forwards to `container_port`, written under `ports`. Null writes the port under `expose` instead: it is not published on the host, and the other services on the network reach it.

host_ip.title: Host Ip
host_ip.description: The IPv4 address on the host that `host_port` listens on. The default accepts connections from this machine only, because the LMA and the GMA have no authentication. Read only when `host_port` is set.

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: What went wrong, in one sentence.

status.title: Status
status.description: Always `ok` when the service answers.

service.title: Service
service.description: The service name, from `APP_NAME`. The default is `dagents-core-service`.

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: The deployment environment, from `APP_ENV`. The default is `development`.

transport.title: Transport
transport.description: How the service is reached. Always `http`.

services.title: Services
services.description: The four services, always in this order: lma, gma, model-service, pipeline-service.

name.title: Name
name.description: The service: `lma`, `gma`, `model-service` or `pipeline-service`.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: `agent` for the LMA and GMA, `service` for the framework services.

base_url.title: Base Url
base_url.description: The address the core service is configured with for this service, from `LMA_URL`, `GMA_URL`, `MODEL_SERVICE_URL` or `PIPELINE_SERVICE_URL`. The core service does not check that it answers.

plan_id.title: Plan Id
plan_id.description: The id to store the plan under. Empty means the service makes one from the clock: `workload-plan-<milliseconds since 1970>`. A plan with the same id replaces the stored one.

namespace.title: Namespace
namespace.description: The Kubernetes namespace every object is placed in.

include_services.title: Include Services
include_services.description: Give every component that has ports a Service.

name.title: Name
name.description: The workload's name. It is the Kubernetes object name and the `app` label its pods carry.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: The main Kubernetes object: `Deployment` keeps pods running, `Job` runs once, `CronJob` runs on a schedule.

replicas.title: Replicas
replicas.description: Number of pods for a `Deployment`. A `Job` or `CronJob` ignores it.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.description: Cron schedule for a `CronJob`. Empty means `0 * * * *`, once an hour. Other kinds ignore it.

ports.title: Ports
ports.description: Ports the container listens on. A component without ports gets no Service.

args.title: Args
args.description: Arguments passed to the container's entry point.

resources.description: CPU and memory requests and limits.

generated_resources.title: Generated Resources
generated_resources.description: Extra objects this component gets even when the request-wide flags are off. `ServiceAccount` is only generated this way.

service_account_name.title: Service Account Name
service_account_name.description: The service account the pods run as. When it is empty and `generated_resources` lists `ServiceAccount`, the component's name is used.

service_type.title: Service Type
service_type.description: The type of the generated Service.

config_map_data.title: Config Map Data
config_map_data.description: Entries for the generated ConfigMap. Empty means two entries: `component-kind` and `image`.

name.title: Name
name.description: The variable's name.

value.title: Value
value.description: Its value. The YAML quotes it, so a number stays a string.

component_name.title: Component Name
component_name.description: The component these objects were rendered for.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: The kind of the main object: `Deployment`, `Job` or `CronJob`.

deployment_yaml.title: Deployment Yaml
deployment_yaml.description: The main object as YAML. Despite the name, it holds a Job or CronJob when `kind` says so.

service_yaml.title: Service Yaml
service_yaml.description: The Service, or null when none was generated.

config_map_yaml.title: Config Map Yaml
config_map_yaml.description: The ConfigMap, or null when none was generated.

service_account_yaml.title: Service Account Yaml
service_account_yaml.description: The ServiceAccount, or null when none was generated.

namespace.title: Namespace
namespace.description: The Kubernetes namespace every object is placed in.

include_services.title: Include Services
include_services.description: Give every component that has ports a Service.

manifests.title: Manifests
manifests.description: One entry per component, in request order.

combined_yaml.title: Combined Yaml
combined_yaml.description: Every object in one YAML document, separated by `---`, ready for `kubectl apply -f`.

plan_id.title: Plan Id
plan_id.description: The id the plan is stored under. Fetch it again with this id.

manifests.title: Manifests
manifests.description: One entry per component, in request order.

combined_yaml.title: Combined Yaml
combined_yaml.description: Every object in one YAML document, separated by `---`, ready for `kubectl apply -f`.

name.title: Name
name.description: The port's name in the container and in the Service.

container_port.title: Container Port
container_port.description: The port the container listens on. A generated Service exposes the same number.

cpu_request.title: Cpu Request
cpu_request.description: CPU the scheduler reserves for the container.

cpu_limit.title: Cpu Limit
cpu_limit.description: Most CPU the container may use.

memory_request.title: Memory Request
memory_request.description: Memory the scheduler reserves for the container.

memory_limit.title: Memory Limit
memory_limit.description: Most memory the container may use.

agent_id.title: Agent Id
agent_id.description: The agent's id. The GMA keys its registry by it.

workspace_id.title: Workspace Id
workspace_id.description: The workspace, or tenant, the agent belongs to.

name.title: Name
name.description: A readable name for the agent.

AgentIdentity.title: AgentIdentity
AgentIdentity.description: Who an agent is: its id, its workspace and its kind.

agent.description: The identity from the agent's last registration or report.

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: From the last registration. Empty when the agent never registered.

version.title: Version
version.description: From the last registration. `unknown` when the agent never registered.

capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.description: From the last registration. Empty when the agent never registered.

status.title: Status
status.description: `REGISTERED` until the first heartbeat, then the last heartbeat's status.

last_seen_at.title: Last Seen At
last_seen_at.description: The `timestamp` of the last heartbeat. Null before the first.

last_heartbeat_status.title: Last Heartbeat Status
last_heartbeat_status.description: The status of the last heartbeat. Null before the first.

last_ingestion_id.title: Last Ingestion Id
last_ingestion_id.description: The `ingestion_id` of the last telemetry envelope received while the agent was known. Null before one.

desired_bundle_id.title: Desired Bundle Id
desired_bundle_id.description: From the last desired deployment stored while the agent was known. Null before one.

desired_bundle_version.title: Desired Bundle Version
desired_bundle_version.description: From the last desired deployment stored while the agent was known. Null before one.

current_bundle_id.title: Current Bundle Id
current_bundle_id.description: From the agent's last deployment sync. Null before one.

current_bundle_version.title: Current Bundle Version
current_bundle_version.description: From the agent's last deployment sync. Null before one.

AgentSnapshot.title: AgentSnapshot
AgentSnapshot.description: What the GMA knows about one agent.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: How contributions are combined: `fedavg`, `fedprox`, `fedopt` or `secure_aggregation`. Only `secure_aggregation` changes a planner decision: it raises the participant floor to `threshold` and requires each completed result to report an `update_norm` of at most 10.

mu.title: Mu
mu.description: The FedProx proximal term. Part of the round digest. The planner uses 0.01 when it is missing.

optimizer.title: Optimizer
optimizer.description: The FedOpt server optimizer, such as `adam`. Part of the round digest. The planner uses `adam` when it is missing.

threshold.title: Threshold
threshold.description: For `secure_aggregation`: the fewest sites whose updates may be combined. It replaces the manifest's `minimum_participants` when it is higher. Set it: without it the planner fails. At least 1.

AggregationMethod.title: AggregationMethod
AggregationMethod.description:
How permitted contributions are combined.

``threshold`` applies to ``secure_aggregation`` and is the number of sites
below which the coordinator must not be able to resolve any single site's
update. The planner treats it as a floor on participation, not a hint.

accepted_sites.title: Accepted Sites
accepted_sites.description: The sites whose results may be combined, sorted by id.

rejected_contributions.title: Rejected Contributions
rejected_contributions.description: Every other stored result, sorted by site id, with the reason.

accepted_examples.title: Accepted Examples
accepted_examples.description: The sum of `contributed_examples` over the accepted sites.

aggregation_permitted.title: Aggregation Permitted
aggregation_permitted.description: True when at least as many results are accepted as the plan's `required_participants`.

stop_reason.title: Stop Reason
stop_reason.description: Null when aggregation is permitted. `excessive_dropout` when some sites dropped out and the accepted and dropped sites together would have been enough; `quorum_not_met` otherwise.

site_weights.title: Site Weights
site_weights.description: Each accepted site's share of `accepted_examples`, adding up to 1. Equal shares when no accepted site reported an example count. The engine uses them when it combines contributions.

AggregationReadiness.title: AggregationReadiness
AggregationReadiness.description:
Whether aggregation may proceed, and on whose contributions.

``site_weights`` follow accepted example counts, the FedAvg convention. They
are reported rather than applied: applying them is the federated runtime's
job, not the control plane's.

audit_id.title: Audit Id
audit_id.description: A random id for the record: a UUID4 in hex, without hyphens.

recorded_at.title: Recorded At
recorded_at.description: When the decision was recorded, in Unix seconds.

requester_id.title: Requester Id
requester_id.description: The requester's id from the request.

permitted.title: Permitted
permitted.description: Whether the Guard let the request go ahead.

filtering_score.title: Filtering Score
filtering_score.description: The plan's filtering score, from 0 to 1.

correlation_id.title: Correlation Id
correlation_id.description: The correlation id sent with the enforcement request, such as a round or run id.

contribution_norm_before.title: Contribution Norm Before
contribution_norm_before.description: The largest L2 norm of a clipped or noised contribution before the Guard changed it. Empty when nothing was bounded.

contribution_norm_after.title: Contribution Norm After
contribution_norm_after.description: The largest L2 norm of a clipped or noised contribution after the Guard changed it. Empty when nothing was bounded.

contribution_strategies.title: Contribution Strategies
contribution_strategies.description: The bounding strategies applied, with their parameters, such as `clip_contribution:1`.

previous_digest.title: Previous Digest
previous_digest.description: The `digest` of the record before this one. Empty for the first record.

digest.title: Digest
digest.description: SHA-256, in hex, of every other field of this record as JSON with sorted keys. Editing or removing a record breaks the chain from that record on.

AuditRecord.title: AuditRecord
AuditRecord.description:
One entry in the Guard's audit log, linked to the entry before it by a digest.

``previous_digest`` and ``digest`` chain entries together, so removing or
editing an entry breaks every digest after it. This is a deterministic
content chain for local integrity checking, not a cryptographic signature;
signing and immutable storage are separate production controls.

The ``contribution_*`` fields are the privacy accounting the planner asks
for when it bounds a contribution with ``clip_contribution`` or
``add_noise``. ``contribution_norm_before`` and ``contribution_norm_after``
are L2 norms (the absolute value for a single number). When a payload holds
several contributions, they record the largest norm before and the largest
norm after. ``contribution_strategies`` lists the strategies applied, with
their parameters. All three stay empty for a decision that bounded nothing.

round_id.title: Round Id
round_id.description: The round that produced the candidate.

candidate_version.title: Candidate Version
candidate_version.description: The candidate's version. The in-process engine writes `<model_version>+<round_id>`.

contributing_sites.title: Contributing Sites
contributing_sites.description: The accepted sites from the readiness check.

site_weights.title: Site Weights
site_weights.description: Each contributing site's weight, from the readiness check.

contributed_examples.title: Contributed Examples
contributed_examples.description: The examples the contributing sites used, from the readiness check.

metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.description: The candidate's metrics. The in-process engine gives the weighted mean of each metric that every contributing site reported, and leaves out a metric only some sites reported.

artifact_uri.title: Artifact Uri
artifact_uri.description: Where the candidate's parameters are. The in-process engine writes `memory://candidates/<round_id>`, which names no file.

artifact_digest.title: Artifact Digest
artifact_digest.description: The digest of the parameters at `artifact_uri`. Empty from the in-process engine, which makes no parameters.

produced_at.title: Produced At
produced_at.description: When the engine made the candidate, in Unix seconds.

CandidateModel.title: CandidateModel
CandidateModel.description:
The model an aggregation produced, before any release decision.

Named "candidate" throughout on purpose. Aggregation produces this; it does
not produce a release. The path from here to a deployed model runs through
cross-site evaluation and a human committee.

``artifact_digest`` identifies the parameters at ``artifact_uri``. A
runtime that produces real parameters sets it, so the next round's manifest
can name them in ``model_artifact_digest``. The in-process simulator
produces no parameters and leaves it empty.

accepted.title: Accepted
accepted.description: True when the command was carried out.

CommandStatus.title: CommandStatus
CommandStatus.description: The answer to a command: whether it was carried out, and what was done.

connection_id.title: Connection Id
connection_id.description: The name of a connection the service's connection resolver knows. The resolver returns that connection's settings, such as host, database and user. An unknown name resolves to no settings.

options.title: Options
options.description: Settings merged over the resolved connection's settings, for this source only; these win. A Postgres source reads `role` here: the role every query runs as.

ConnectionRef.title: ConnectionRef
ConnectionRef.description: A named connection, with settings that apply to one source only.

site_id.title: Site Id
site_id.description: The site whose result does not count.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: The first check it failed, such as `site reported a failed run` or `returned job digest does not match the round manifest`.

ContributionRejection.title: ContributionRejection
ContributionRejection.description: One contribution that may not enter the aggregate, and why.

classification_id.title: Classification Id
classification_id.description: The classification's id. Condition packs name a classification by it.

field_sensitivity.title: Field Sensitivity
field_sensitivity.description: Field names mapped to their sensitivity: `low`, `medium` or `high`.

default_sensitivity.title: Default Sensitivity
default_sensitivity.description: The sensitivity of every field not in `field_sensitivity`. Default `high`, the most protected.

regulations.title: Regulations
regulations.description: Regulations that cover the data, such as `HIPAA`. Each adds an obligation to every plan.

minimum_cohort.title: Minimum Cohort
minimum_cohort.description: The fewest subjects a `column`, `table` or `model_update` result may describe. 0 turns the check off. At least 0.

DataClassification.title: DataClassification
DataClassification.description:
How sensitive each field is, and which regulations cover the data.

This is the data-side half of a restriction decision. It is configuration, not code: policy changes far more often than the
framework does. ``default_sensitivity`` is ``"high"`` so an unclassified
field is treated as the most protected until someone classifies it.

inline_records.title: Inline Records
inline_records.description: Records sent in the request. When not empty they are used, and `source` and `source_id` are ignored.

source.title: Source
source.description: A source definition sent with the request. It is read for this request and not stored.

source_id.title: Source Id
source_id.description: The id of a source registered with the same service (`POST /api/v1/sources`). Used when `inline_records` and `source` are empty. An unknown id fails the request.

DatasetInput.title: DatasetInput
DatasetInput.description: Where a request's records come from. At least one of the three fields must be set.

scope_kind.title: Scope Kind
scope_kind.description: `source` when an LMA made the profile, `assimilated` when the GMA did.

extraction_strategy.title: Extraction Strategy
extraction_strategy.description: The request's extraction strategy. For a model run, the one inferred from the records.

feature_fields.title: Feature Fields
feature_fields.description: The fields profiled: the request's `feature_fields`, or every field of the first record except the label.

numeric_fields.title: Numeric Fields
numeric_fields.description: Feature fields whose first non-null value is a number. A boolean does not count as a number.

categorical_fields.title: Categorical Fields
categorical_fields.description: Every other feature field, including a field that is null in every record.

partition_count.title: Partition Count
partition_count.description: `record_count` divided by `batch_size`, rounded up. 0 when there are no records.

suggested_models.title: Suggested Models
suggested_models.description: Two or three model families, chosen by fixed rules from the extraction strategy, whether there is a label, and whether any feature field is numeric.

DatasetProfile.title: DatasetProfile
DatasetProfile.description: What a profile found in a set of records: their count, their fields and the models that suit them.

scope_id.title: Scope Id
scope_id.description: A name for the data, such as the source or tenant it belongs to. It is copied into the profile.

scope_kind.title: Scope Kind
scope_kind.description: `source` for data from one source, `assimilated` for data combined from several. The agent decides: the LMA always records `source` and the GMA `assimilated`, whatever the request says.

extraction_strategy.title: Extraction Strategy
extraction_strategy.description: How the data is read. It changes the suggested models: `time_series` suggests gru, lstm and autoencoder, and `text` suggests naive_bayes, gru and transformer.

dataset.description: Where the records come from: records in the request, a source sent with the request, or the id of a registered source. When it is set, `records` is ignored.

records.title: Records
records.description: Records sent directly. The older way to send data, used only when `dataset` is not set.

feature_fields.title: Feature Fields
feature_fields.description: The fields to profile. Empty means every field of the first record except `label_field`.

label_field.title: Label Field
label_field.description: The field that holds the label, for supervised tasks. It is left out of the inferred feature fields. When it is set, the profile suggests classification models.

batch_size.title: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Records per partition: `partition_count` is the record count divided by this, rounded up. At least 1.

DatasetProfileRequest.title: DatasetProfileRequest
DatasetProfileRequest.description: A request to profile a set of records.

plan_token.title: Plan Token
plan_token.description: `plan-` and the first 12 hex digits of `config_digest`.

config_digest.title: Config Digest
config_digest.description: SHA-256, in hex, of `<agent_id>:<bundle_id>:<bundle_version>:<bundle_uri>:<config>`, with the config written in Python dict notation. The same request gives the same digest.

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: When the plan was stored, in Unix seconds.

DeploymentPlan.title: DeploymentPlan
DeploymentPlan.description: A stored desired deployment for one agent.

agent.description: The agent reporting. An agent that never registered is added, with version `unknown`.

bundle_id.title: Bundle Id
bundle_id.description: The bundle the agent runs now. Stored as `current_bundle_id`.

bundle_version.title: Bundle Version
bundle_version.description: The version the agent runs now. Stored as `current_bundle_version`.

DeploymentSyncRequest.title: DeploymentSyncRequest
DeploymentSyncRequest.description: An agent's report of the bundle it runs now.

up_to_date.title: Up To Date
up_to_date.description: True when the agent runs the desired bundle and version, or when no deployment is planned for it.

plan_token.title: Plan Token
plan_token.description: The desired deployment's `plan_token`. Empty when none is planned.

config_digest.title: Config Digest
config_digest.description: The desired deployment's `config_digest`. Empty when none is planned.

desired_bundle_id.title: Desired Bundle Id
desired_bundle_id.description: The bundle to run. Null when none is planned.

desired_bundle_version.title: Desired Bundle Version
desired_bundle_version.description: The version to run. Null when none is planned.

desired_bundle_uri.title: Desired Bundle Uri
desired_bundle_uri.description: Where the bundle's files are. Null when none is planned.

DeploymentSyncResponse.title: DeploymentSyncResponse
DeploymentSyncResponse.description: Whether the agent runs the bundle the GMA wants it to run.

agent_id.title: Agent Id
agent_id.description: The agent the deployment is for.

bundle_uri.title: Bundle Uri
bundle_uri.description: Where the bundle's files are. Stored, not fetched.

config.title: Config
config.description: Settings for the bundle. Stored, and part of the digest.

DesiredDeploymentRequest.title: DesiredDeploymentRequest
DesiredDeploymentRequest.description: The bundle the GMA should want one agent to run.

dispatched_at.title: Dispatched At
dispatched_at.description: When the dispatch was recorded, in Unix seconds.

status.title: Status
status.description: Always `QUEUED`. Nothing in this version runs a dispatch or changes its status.

DispatchedRun.title: DispatchedRun
DispatchedRun.description: A run dispatch the GMA has recorded.

ErrorDetail.title: ErrorDetail
ErrorDetail.description: The body of an error the handler raises itself.

extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.description: The registered extensions, in the order they were registered.

feature_contracts.title: Feature Contracts
feature_contracts.description: Every registered feature contract, sorted by id.

classifications.title: Classifications
classifications.description: The ids of the data classifications extensions contribute, sorted. Classifications registered at runtime through the governance endpoints are not listed here.

condition_packs.title: Condition Packs
condition_packs.description: Every registered condition pack, sorted by id.

pipeline_steps.title: Pipeline Steps
pipeline_steps.description: The names of the contributed pipeline steps, sorted.

model_adapters.title: Model Adapters
model_adapters.description: The names of the contributed model adapters, sorted.

ExtensionSummary.title: ExtensionSummary
ExtensionSummary.description:
What the registered extensions contribute, as an agent's extensions endpoint returns it.

`ExtensionRegistry.describe` builds this shape as a plain dict. The model
documents it in the OpenAPI schema; it is not used to build the response.

sensitivity.title: Sensitivity
sensitivity.description: The field's sensitivity, from the classification.

strategy.title: Strategy
strategy.description: What the Guard does with the field: `allow_full`, `generalize:<level>`, `clip_contribution:<bound>`, `add_noise:<scale>`, `aggregate_only:<minimum cohort>`, `redact` or `refuse`.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why the strategy was chosen, such as `sensitivity=high trust=high granularity=row -> generalize:1`.

FieldRestriction.title: FieldRestriction
FieldRestriction.description:
The strategy selected for one requested field.

``strategy`` keeps its parameter in the string (``"clip_contribution:1"``,
``"aggregate_only:20"``) so an audit record shows the bound that was
applied, not only the strategy's name.

telemetry_events.title: Telemetry Events
telemetry_events.description: Telemetry envelopes received, counted up to 100,000.

pending_deployments.title: Pending Deployments
pending_deployments.description: Agents whose desired bundle differs from the bundle they last reported.

dispatched_runs.title: Dispatched Runs
dispatched_runs.description: Run dispatches plus aggregate model runs, each counted up to 100,000.

FleetOverview.title: FleetOverview
FleetOverview.description: Counts of what the GMA holds.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: `at_least`: the metric must be at least `value`. `at_most`: at most `value`. `improves_on_baseline`: at least the baseline's value plus `margin`.

value.title: Value
value.description: The limit for `at_least` and `at_most`. The planner uses 0 when it is missing.

margin.title: Margin
margin.description: How much `improves_on_baseline` asks the candidate to gain over the baseline. The planner uses 0 when it is missing.

GateComparison.title: GateComparison
GateComparison.description: How a release gate compares an observed metric to its requirement.

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.description: `passed`, `failed`, or `not_evaluated` when the candidate has no such metric (or, for `improves_on_baseline`, the baseline has none).

observed.title: Observed
observed.description: The candidate's value for the metric. Null when it has none.

threshold.title: Threshold
threshold.description: The value `observed` was compared with: the gate's `value`, or the baseline plus the margin. Null when an improvement gate has no baseline value.

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: The comparison in words, such as `accuracy=0.84 required >= 0.8`.

GateResult.title: GateResult
GateResult.description:
Evaluation of one release gate against a candidate's metrics.

``threshold`` is the value the planner compared ``observed`` with: the
gate's value for ``at_least`` and ``at_most``, and baseline + margin for
``improves_on_baseline``. It is ``None`` when an improvement gate has no
baseline metric. Read it from here; do not recompute it.

status.title: Status
status.description: `ok` whenever the process answers.

chain_intact.title: Chain Intact
chain_intact.description: Whether the log's digest chain verifies. Records an earlier check already verified are not hashed again; only newer ones are.

records.title: Records
records.description: The newest records first, at most `limit` of them.

GuardAuditLog.title: GuardAuditLog
GuardAuditLog.description:
The audit log as an agent's audit endpoint returns it.

The endpoints build this shape as a plain dict. The model documents it in
the OpenAPI schema; it is not used to build the response.

permitted.title: Permitted
permitted.description: Whether the request may go ahead. False for a `deny` plan, and when the planner cannot be reached.

plan.description: The plan the Guard applied. When the planner cannot be reached, a deny plan the Guard builds itself.

payload.title: Payload
payload.description: The records after enforcement: only the requested fields, each changed by its strategy, or one summary row when a field is `aggregate_only`. Empty when the request is denied, when every requested field is withheld, and when an aggregate group is smaller than its minimum.

withheld_fields.title: Withheld Fields
withheld_fields.description: Requested fields that were removed: redacted, refused, or holding a value the strategy could not be applied to. Every requested field when the request is denied.

transformed_fields.title: Transformed Fields
transformed_fields.description: Requested fields returned with changed values: generalized, clipped, noised or aggregated.

audit_id.title: Audit Id
audit_id.description: The id of the audit record written for this decision.

message.title: Message
message.description: The result in words, such as `permitted with restrictions`.

GuardDecision.title: GuardDecision
GuardDecision.description:
What the Ethical Guard did with a request after the planner decided.

The plan says what should happen; this says what happened. ``permitted`` is
the answer the caller acts on, ``payload`` is what survived enforcement, and
``withheld_fields`` names what did not, so a narrowed response is never
mistaken for a complete one.

request.description: The request to plan and enforce.

payload.title: Payload
payload.description: The records the request would return. The Guard applies the plan to them and returns what is left. Empty asks for a decision only.

correlation_id.title: Correlation Id
correlation_id.description: An id that ties the decision to other work, such as a round or run id. Written into the audit record.

GuardEnforcementRequest.title: GuardEnforcementRequest
GuardEnforcementRequest.description: A restriction request plus the payload the Guard should enforce against.

agent.description: The agent sending the heartbeat. An agent that never registered is added, with version `unknown`.

status.title: Status
status.description: The agent's state in its own words, such as `ACTIVE`. Stored as the agent's `status`. The overview counts an agent as active when this is `ACTIVE` or `SYNC_REQUIRED`.

timestamp.title: Timestamp
timestamp.description: When the agent sent it, in Unix seconds. Stored as `last_seen_at`; not checked.

HeartbeatRequest.title: HeartbeatRequest
HeartbeatRequest.description: A sign of life from an agent, with its state.

desired_state.title: Desired State
desired_state.description: `SYNC_REQUIRED` when the agent's record has a desired bundle that differs from the bundle it last reported, otherwise `ACTIVE`.

HeartbeatResponse.title: HeartbeatResponse
HeartbeatResponse.description: The GMA's answer to a heartbeat.

records.title: Records
records.description: The records themselves, one JSON object per record.

InlineSelection.title: InlineSelection
InlineSelection.description: The records of an inline source.

source_id.title: Source Id
source_id.description: The id the source is stored under. Registering another source with the same id replaces it.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Which adapter reads the source: `inline`, `postgres`, `mongodb` or `object_storage`. It also decides which of the four source shapes the body must have.

connection_ref.description: Not used by inline sources.

selection.description: The records themselves.

format.title: Format
format.description: `rows` or `json`. Stored; the inline adapter reads `selection.records` either way.

schema_hint.title: Schema Hint
schema_hint.description: Field names mapped to type names. The planner's `dataset source` commands read it when a service sends them the source; the source adapters do not.

batching.description: How the records are split into batches when the source is read.

checkpoint.title: Checkpoint
checkpoint.description: Where to resume reading. Passed to the adapter; the four adapters in this version ignore it.

options.title: Options
options.description: Settings for the adapter. The inline adapter reads none.

InlineSourceSpec.title: InlineSourceSpec
InlineSourceSpec.description: Records sent inside the source definition itself.

kyu_score.title: Kyu Score
kyu_score.description: The Know-Your-User score, from 0 to 1: 0.7 times the share of attribute weight that is earned (an unverified attribute earns a quarter of its weight), plus 0.3 times `compliance_history`. 0 when the requester has no attributes.

rationale.title: Rationale
rationale.description: The inputs behind the score, one per entry, such as `verified_attributes=2/2`.

KyuAssessment.title: KyuAssessment
KyuAssessment.description: Computed trust for one requester, with the reasoning behind it.

attribute_id.title: Attribute Id
attribute_id.description: What the signal is, for example `email_domain` or `signed_agreement`.

weight.title: Weight
weight.description: How much the signal counts toward the trust score. At least 0.

verified.title: Verified
verified.description: Whether the signal has been checked. An unverified signal counts for a quarter of its weight. Default false, so a signal nobody marked is not treated as checked.

KyuAttribute.title: KyuAttribute
KyuAttribute.description:
One signal feeding a Know-Your-User score.

``verified`` defaults to ``False`` on purpose: an attribute a caller forgot
to mark must not be treated as checked.

scope_id.title: Scope Id
scope_id.description: A name for the data. It is part of the run id and of the artifact path.

scope_kind.title: Scope Kind
scope_kind.description: `source` for data from one source, `assimilated` for data combined from several. The agent decides: the LMA always records `source` and the GMA `assimilated`, whatever the request says.

task_type.title: Task Type
task_type.description: The task. It is copied into the run record; `forecasting` makes the profile use `time_series`.

model_family.title: Model Family
model_family.description: The model family to record. It sets the base of the estimated `quality_score` and the artifact's file name. No model is trained.

dataset.description: Where the records come from: records in the request, a source sent with the request, or the id of a registered source. When it is set, `records` is ignored.

records.title: Records
records.description: Records sent directly. The older way to send data, used only when `dataset` is not set.

feature_fields.title: Feature Fields
feature_fields.description: The fields to profile. Empty means every field of the first record except `label_field`.

label_field.title: Label Field
label_field.description: The field that holds the label, for supervised tasks. It is left out of the inferred feature fields.

hyperparameters.title: Hyperparameters
hyperparameters.description: Settings for the run. Only `batch_size` is read (default 1000): it sets `batch_count` and the profile's partitions.

artifact_prefix.title: Artifact Prefix
artifact_prefix.description: The start of `artifact_uri`. No file is written.

ModelExecutionRequest.title: ModelExecutionRequest
ModelExecutionRequest.description: A request to run a model over a set of records and record the run.

dataset_profile.description: The profile of the records the run read.

run.description: The run record. The agent also keeps it in its run history.

ModelExecutionResponse.title: ModelExecutionResponse
ModelExecutionResponse.description: The result of a model run: the profile of its records and the run record.

run_id.title: Run Id
run_id.description: `<role>-<scope_id>-<start time in seconds>`, for example `lma-hospital-a-1760000000`. Two runs for one scope in the same second get the same id.

agent_role.title: Agent Role
agent_role.description: Who ran it: `LMA`, `GMA`, or `SERVICE` for a step of the pipeline service's engine.

scope_kind.title: Scope Kind
scope_kind.description: `source` from an LMA, `assimilated` from the GMA.

record_count.title: Record Count
record_count.description: How many records the run read.

feature_count.title: Feature Count
feature_count.description: How many feature fields the profile found.

batch_count.title: Batch Count
batch_count.description: `record_count` divided by the `batch_size` hyperparameter, rounded up. 0 when there are no records.

status.title: Status
status.description: `completed`. A run that raises an error is not recorded, so the agents never store `failed`.

metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.description: Estimates, not measurements. `quality_score` is a fixed base per model family, plus 0.15 x min(1, max(0.1, records / 10,000)), plus 0.04 on the GMA, at most 0.99. `throughput_rows_per_batch` is the record count divided by the partition count, rounded up. `feature_coverage` is the number of feature fields divided by that number plus the number of categorical fields.

artifact_uri.title: Artifact Uri
artifact_uri.description: `<artifact_prefix>/<role>/<scope_id>/<model_family>-<model_version>.json`. A name only; no file is written.

started_at.title: Started At
started_at.description: When the run started, in Unix seconds.

completed_at.title: Completed At
completed_at.description: When the run ended, in Unix seconds.

filter.title: Filter
filter.description: A MongoDB query filter. Stored with the source; not applied in this version.

projection.title: Projection
projection.description: A MongoDB projection. Stored with the source; not applied in this version.

sort.title: Sort
sort.description: A MongoDB sort order. Stored with the source; not applied in this version.

MongoSelection.title: MongoSelection
MongoSelection.description:
What a MongoDB source reads.

This version has no live MongoDB connector. The adapter returns the
documents in the source's `options.documents` or in its connection's
`documents`, so `filter`, `projection` and `sort` are stored but not applied.

source_id.title: Source Id
source_id.description: The id the source is stored under. Registering another source with the same id replaces it.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Which adapter reads the source: `inline`, `postgres`, `mongodb` or `object_storage`. It also decides which of the four source shapes the body must have.

connection_ref.description: The connection to read through. Its settings may hold `documents` to return.

selection.description: The database and collection to read.

format.title: Format
format.description: `rows`, `bson` or `json`. Stored; the adapter returns the documents as they are.

schema_hint.title: Schema Hint
schema_hint.description: Field names mapped to type names. The planner's `dataset source` commands read it when a service sends them the source; the source adapters do not.

batching.description: How the records are split into batches when the source is read.

checkpoint.title: Checkpoint
checkpoint.description: Where to resume reading. Passed to the adapter; the four adapters in this version ignore it.

options.title: Options
options.description: Settings for the adapter. `documents` holds the documents to return. Without it, and without `documents` in the connection, reading the source fails.

MongoSourceSpec.title: MongoSourceSpec
MongoSourceSpec.description: A MongoDB collection. This version returns fixed documents instead of querying a server.

uri.title: Uri
uri.description: The file to read: a local path or a `file://` URI. One of `uri` and `prefix` is required.

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: Read as the file's path when `uri` is not set.

glob.title: Glob
glob.description: A file name pattern. Stored; not applied in this version.

compression.title: Compression
compression.description: The file's compression. Stored; not applied in this version.

ObjectStorageSelection.title: ObjectStorageSelection
ObjectStorageSelection.description: The file an object-storage source reads. This version reads local files only.

source_id.title: Source Id
source_id.description: The id the source is stored under. Registering another source with the same id replaces it.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Which adapter reads the source: `inline`, `postgres`, `mongodb` or `object_storage`. It also decides which of the four source shapes the body must have.

connection_ref.description: Required, but not used by the local file adapter.

selection.description: The file to read.

format.title: Format
format.description: How the file is parsed: `json` (a list of objects, or one object), `jsonl` (one object per line) or `csv` (a header row, then one record per row). `parquet` is accepted, but reading it fails in this version.

schema_hint.title: Schema Hint
schema_hint.description: Field names mapped to type names. The planner's `dataset source` commands read it when a service sends them the source; the source adapters do not.

batching.description: How the records are split into batches when the source is read.

checkpoint.title: Checkpoint
checkpoint.description: Where to resume reading. Passed to the adapter; the four adapters in this version ignore it.

options.title: Options
options.description: Settings for the adapter. The file adapter reads none.

ObjectStorageSourceSpec.title: ObjectStorageSourceSpec
ObjectStorageSourceSpec.description: A file of records. This version reads local paths and `file://` URIs only.

sql.title: Sql
sql.description: A complete SQL query. When it is set, `table`, `columns`, `where` and `order_by` are ignored.

table.title: Table
table.description: The table to read when `sql` is not set. One of `sql` and `table` is required.

columns.title: Columns
columns.description: The columns to read from `table`. Empty reads every column (`*`).

where.title: Where
where.description: A SQL condition added to the table query as `WHERE`.

order_by.title: Order By
order_by.description: Columns for the table query's `ORDER BY`.

PostgresSelection.title: PostgresSelection
PostgresSelection.description: What a Postgres source reads: a SQL query, or a table with optional columns, filter and order.

source_id.title: Source Id
source_id.description: The id the source is stored under. Registering another source with the same id replaces it.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Which adapter reads the source: `inline`, `postgres`, `mongodb` or `object_storage`. It also decides which of the four source shapes the body must have.

connection_ref.description: The connection to read through. Its `options.role` sets the role each query runs as.

selection.description: The query, or the table, to read.

format.title: Format
format.description: Always `rows`.

schema_hint.title: Schema Hint
schema_hint.description: Field names mapped to type names. The planner's `dataset source` commands read it when a service sends them the source; the source adapters do not.

batching.description: How the records are split into batches when the source is read.

checkpoint.title: Checkpoint
checkpoint.description: Where to resume reading. Passed to the adapter; the four adapters in this version ignore it.

options.title: Options
options.description: Settings for the adapter. `rows` holds fixed records that are returned instead of running the query; tests and demos use it.

PostgresSourceSpec.title: PostgresSourceSpec
PostgresSourceSpec.description: A PostgreSQL table or query, read through psycopg.

agent.description: Who the agent is. The GMA stores the agent under `agent.agent_id`.

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: Labels for what the agent covers, such as a tenant or a source. Stored.

capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.description: What the agent can do. Stored, and copied into the response.

RegisterRequest.title: RegisterRequest
RegisterRequest.description: An agent's registration with the GMA.

accepted.title: Accepted
accepted.description: Always true: the GMA accepts every registration.

deployment_plan_id.title: Deployment Plan Id
deployment_plan_id.description: The `plan_token` of the desired deployment stored for this agent. Null when there is none.

RegisterResponse.title: RegisterResponse
RegisterResponse.description: The GMA's answer to a registration.

RegisteredConditionPack.title: RegisteredConditionPack
RegisteredConditionPack.description: One registered condition pack, as `ExtensionRegistry.describe` lists it.

extension_id.title: Extension Id
extension_id.description: The extension's id. Two extensions cannot share one.

RegisteredExtension.title: RegisteredExtension
RegisteredExtension.description: One registered extension, as `ExtensionRegistry.describe` lists it.

version.title: Version
version.description: The contract's version. Sites compare it before they join a federated round.

RegisteredFeatureContract.title: RegisteredFeatureContract
RegisteredFeatureContract.description: One registered feature contract, as `ExtensionRegistry.describe` lists it.

round_id.title: Round Id
round_id.description: The round the candidate came from.

candidate_version.title: Candidate Version
candidate_version.description: The candidate's version, copied from the request.

gate_results.title: Gate Results
gate_results.description: One result per gate, in the order of the request.

action.title: Action
action.description: `reject` when a blocking gate did not pass; otherwise `another_round` when any gate did not pass; otherwise `release`. A `release` is a recommendation to the people who approve releases; nothing is deployed.

blocking_failures.title: Blocking Failures
blocking_failures.description: `<gate_id>: <detail>` for each blocking gate that did not pass.

rollback_version.title: Rollback Version
rollback_version.description: The version to keep using if the candidate is not released: the request's `rollback_version`, or the round's `model_version`.

ReleaseDecision.title: ReleaseDecision
ReleaseDecision.description:
The governed verdict on a candidate model.

A ``release`` action is a recommendation to a human committee, never an
automatic deployment.

gates.title: Gates
gates.description: The gates to evaluate, in order, usually a condition pack's `release_gates`. With no gates the decision is `release`.

candidate_version.title: Candidate Version
candidate_version.description: The candidate's version, as `POST /api/v1/federation/rounds/{round_id}:aggregate` returned it. It is not checked against the round.

candidate_metrics.title: Candidate Metrics
candidate_metrics.description: The candidate's measured metrics, by name. The gates read these values as sent.

baseline_metrics.title: Baseline Metrics
baseline_metrics.description: The approved model's metrics, by name. Only `improves_on_baseline` gates read them.

rollback_version.title: Rollback Version
rollback_version.description: The version to keep using if the candidate is not released. Default: the round's `model_version`.

ReleaseEvaluationRequest.title: ReleaseEvaluationRequest
ReleaseEvaluationRequest.description:
A candidate's measured metrics, with the gates it must clear.

``baseline_metrics`` are the current approved model's, needed by any gate
that asks for an improvement rather than an absolute threshold.

gate_id.title: Gate Id
gate_id.description: The gate's id. It names the gate in `gate_results` and `blocking_failures`.

metric.title: Metric
metric.description: The name of the candidate metric the gate reads, such as `accuracy`.

comparison.description: What the metric is compared with.

blocking.title: Blocking
blocking.description: Whether a gate that does not pass rejects the candidate. Default true. A non-blocking gate that does not pass asks for another round instead.

ReleaseGate.title: ReleaseGate
ReleaseGate.description:
One condition a candidate must satisfy before it may be released.

``blocking`` defaults to ``True``: a gate whose severity nobody stated must
not be treated as advisory.

requester_id.title: Requester Id
requester_id.description: Who is asking. Written into the plan's assessment and the audit record.

requester_kind.title: Requester Kind
requester_kind.description: `human`, `site`, `coordinator` or `service`. Written into the trust rationale; it does not change the score.

affiliation.title: Affiliation
affiliation.description: The organization the requester belongs to. Written into the rationale; it does not change the score.

stated_purpose.title: Stated Purpose
stated_purpose.description: Why the requester says it is asking. Written into the rationale. The purpose check reads the request's `declared_purpose`, not this field.

attributes.title: Attributes
attributes.description: The signals the trust score is computed from. With none, the score is 0 and trust is `low`.

compliance_history.title: Compliance History
compliance_history.description: The requester's record of past compliance, from 0 to 1. It is 30% of the trust score.

Requester.title: Requester
Requester.description:
The party asking for data, an update, or a release.

``requester_kind`` carries the federated extension. A requester is not
always a named human: it can be a peer site or the coordinator itself, and
trust in a coordinator is a different question from trust in a person.

assessment.description: How far the planner trusts the requester, and why.

field_restrictions.title: Field Restrictions
field_restrictions.description: One entry per requested field, in the order of the request.

decision.title: Decision
decision.description: `deny` when a request-level check fails or any field is `refuse`, `permit` when every field is `allow_full`, and `narrow` otherwise.

filtering_score.title: Filtering Score
filtering_score.description: How much protection the plan applies, from 0 (nothing withheld) to 1 (refused): the mean weight of the fields' strategies. The weights are allow_full 0, generalize 0.35, clip_contribution 0.45, add_noise 0.55, aggregate_only 0.7, redact 0.9 and refuse 1.

obligations.title: Obligations
obligations.description: Duties the Guard must carry out, such as recording the decision, applying each regulation's controls and suppressing groups below the minimum cohort.

violations.title: Violations
violations.description: Request-level checks that failed: a missing or unapproved purpose, or a missing or too small cohort. Any violation makes the decision `deny`.

RestrictionPlan.title: RestrictionPlan
RestrictionPlan.description:
The planner's decision for one request: a strategy for each field, and a verdict.

``filtering_score`` is GRAILS' measure of how much protection was actually
applied, so the amount of filtering can be reported rather than asserted:
0.0 means nothing was withheld, 1.0 means the request was fully refused.

request_id.title: Request Id
request_id.description: An id for the request, chosen by the caller. It is copied into the plan, the decision and the audit record, and it seeds the random noise `add_noise` draws, so a decision can be reproduced.

boundary.title: Boundary
boundary.description: Where the Guard stands: `before_read`, `before_train`, `before_send` or `before_release`. It is recorded in the plan and the audit record; it does not change the strategy chosen.

requester.description: Who is asking. The planner computes the requester's trust from it.

classification.description: The classification to plan against, sent in full. It is not looked up by its id.

requested_fields.title: Requested Fields
requested_fields.description: The fields asked for. The plan has one restriction per field, and the Guard drops every other field from the payload.

granularity.title: Granularity
granularity.description: How much is asked for: `cell`, `row`, `column`, `table` or `model_update` (a federated model update).

cohort_size.title: Cohort Size
cohort_size.description: How many subjects the result describes. Required for `column`, `table` and `model_update` requests when the classification's `minimum_cohort` is above 0. Below that minimum, the request is denied. At least 0.

declared_purpose.title: Declared Purpose
declared_purpose.description: Why the data is wanted. When `approved_purposes` is not empty, it is required and must be one of them.

approved_purposes.title: Approved Purposes
approved_purposes.description: The purposes allowed for this data. Empty turns the purpose check off.

RestrictionRequest.title: RestrictionRequest
RestrictionRequest.description:
One request for data, an update or a release, as the governance planner reads it.

The planner's governance rules are the Ethical-Restriction Rails.

round_id.title: Round Id
round_id.description: The round's id, chosen by the caller. The GMA stores the round under it; dispatching a manifest whose id is already stored replaces that round.

study_id.title: Study Id
study_id.description: The study the round belongs to. Copied into the plan.

condition_id.title: Condition Id
condition_id.description: What the study is about, named in the application's own words. A site is selected only when its `approved_conditions` include it.

phase.title: Phase
phase.description: `analytics`, `evaluation` or `training`. Copied into the plan. The in-process engine turns it into each site's task: `profile`, `evaluate` or `train`.

model_version.title: Model Version
model_version.description: The model version the round starts from. A candidate from the round names it as `parent_version`, and a release decision falls back to it as the rollback version.

model_artifact_digest.title: Model Artifact Digest
model_artifact_digest.description: The digest of the approved model parameters. Part of the round digest; the GMA does not check it.

training_code_digest.title: Training Code Digest
training_code_digest.description: The digest of the approved training code. Part of the round digest. A site that checked it sets `code_verified` in its result.

feature_contract_version.title: Feature Contract Version
feature_contract_version.description: The feature contract the round reads. A site is selected only when its `feature_contract_version` is the same.

privacy_profile.title: Privacy Profile
privacy_profile.description: A name for the privacy settings the sites apply. Part of the round digest; no rule reads it.

aggregation.description: How the accepted contributions are combined.

minimum_participants.title: Minimum Participants
minimum_participants.description: The fewest selected sites for quorum, and the fewest accepted results for aggregation. A higher `secure_aggregation` threshold replaces it. At least 1.

minimum_cohort_per_site.title: Minimum Cohort Per Site
minimum_cohort_per_site.description: The fewest subjects a site must hold to be selected (`cohort_size`) and must use for its result to count (`contributed_examples`). At least 0.

required_capabilities.title: Required Capabilities
required_capabilities.description: Capabilities every selected site must declare, such as `evaluate`.

stop_conditions.title: Stop Conditions
stop_conditions.description: The conditions the study says stop a round. Part of the round digest only: the planner sets `quorum_not_met` or `excessive_dropout` whether or not they are listed, and never sets the others.

invited_sites.title: Invited Sites
invited_sites.description: The sites asked to take part. Only these can be selected. An invited site with no enrolment is listed as excluded.

RoundManifest.title: RoundManifest
RoundManifest.description:
The round contract distributed to every approved site.

A site verifies this before any code touches local data: the digests say
which model and which training code were approved, and
``feature_contract_version`` says which fields the round may read.

selected_sites.title: Selected Sites
selected_sites.description: Stored sites that passed every check, in this order: `enrolled` is true, invited, condition approved, same feature contract, every required capability, large enough cohort. Sorted by id.

excluded_sites.title: Excluded Sites
excluded_sites.description: Every other stored site, sorted by id, then each invited site that has no stored enrolment.

quorum_met.title: Quorum Met
quorum_met.description: True when `selected_sites` holds at least `required_participants` sites.

required_participants.title: Required Participants
required_participants.description: `minimum_participants`, or the `secure_aggregation` threshold when that is higher.

aggregation.description: The manifest's aggregation method, with the planner's defaults filled in.

stop_reason.title: Stop Reason
stop_reason.description: `quorum_not_met` when quorum is not met, otherwise null.

round_digest.title: Round Digest
round_digest.description: `fnv1a:` and 16 hex digits: an FNV-1a hash of the manifest's fields. A site's result must return it as `job_digest`. It detects a changed manifest; it is not a cryptographic signature.

RoundPlan.title: RoundPlan
RoundPlan.description:
The compiled, reviewable plan for one round.

``required_participants`` is the effective floor, which may exceed the
manifest's stated minimum when a secure-aggregation threshold is stricter.

manifest.description: The manifest the round was dispatched with.

plan.description: The planner's plan for the round.

results.title: Results
results.description: One result per site, sorted by site id. A later result from a site replaces its earlier one.

readiness.description: The last readiness check, saved by the readiness and aggregate endpoints. Null before either.

decision.description: The release decision, saved by the evaluate-release endpoint. Null before it.

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: When the round was dispatched, in Unix seconds.

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: When the record last changed, in Unix seconds.

status.title: Status
status.description: `collecting` after a dispatch that met quorum or a new result, `aggregated` after a candidate was made, `closed` after a dispatch without quorum or a release decision. The GMA never stores `planned` or `dispatched`.

RoundRecord.title: RoundRecord
RoundRecord.description:
The GMA's stored lineage for one round.

Kept so the path from seed model to round to candidate to release can be
reconstructed later without reading any site's local evidence.

agent_id.title: Agent Id
agent_id.description: The agent that should run it. It must be registered, or the dispatch is refused.

correlation_id.title: Correlation Id
correlation_id.description: An id for the run, chosen by the caller.

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: Labels for what the run covers, such as a table.

RunDispatchRequest.title: RunDispatchRequest
RunDispatchRequest.description: A request to record a run for an agent.

site_id.title: Site Id
site_id.description: The site that will not take part.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: The first eligibility check it failed, such as `site lacks required capability evaluate`.

SiteExclusion.title: SiteExclusion
SiteExclusion.description: One invited site that will not take part, and why.

site_id.title: Site Id
site_id.description: The site's id. Enrolling the same id again replaces the stored enrolment.

capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.description: What the site can do, such as `evaluate` or `train`. A round's `required_capabilities` must all be here.

feature_contract_version.title: Feature Contract Version
feature_contract_version.description: The version of the feature contract (the agreed list of fields) the site has signed. It must equal the round's `feature_contract_version`.

approved_conditions.title: Approved Conditions
approved_conditions.description: The conditions (study topics) the site has approved. The round's `condition_id` must be one of them.

policy_version.title: Policy Version
policy_version.description: The version of the site's local policy. Stored; no rule reads it.

cohort_size.title: Cohort Size
cohort_size.description: How many subjects the site holds. It must be at least the round's `minimum_cohort_per_site`. At least 0.

enrolled.title: Enrolled
enrolled.description: Whether the site has agreed to take part. Default false: a site that does not say so is never selected.

SiteRegistration.title: SiteRegistration
SiteRegistration.description:
One site's standing enrolment in a study.

``enrolled`` defaults to ``False``: taking part has to be stated, never
inferred from the presence of a record.

round_id.title: Round Id
round_id.description: The round the result belongs to.

site_id.title: Site Id
site_id.description: The site that sends it. A later result from the same site replaces this one.

job_digest.title: Job Digest
job_digest.description: The round digest the site received with its job. A completed result counts only when it equals the plan's `round_digest`.

participation.title: Participation
participation.description: `accepted` (not finished yet), `completed`, `rejected` (the site refused the job), `failed` or `dropped`. Only a `completed` result can count.

code_verified.title: Code Verified
code_verified.description: Whether the site checked the training code digest. A completed result counts only when it is true.

privacy_checks_passed.title: Privacy Checks Passed
privacy_checks_passed.description: Whether the site's privacy checks passed. A completed result counts only when it is true.

contributed_examples.title: Contributed Examples
contributed_examples.description: How many examples the site used. A completed result counts only when it is at least the manifest's `minimum_cohort_per_site`. It sets the site's weight. At least 0.

update_norm.title: Update Norm
update_norm.description: The L2 norm (length) of the site's clipped model update, when it sent one. Under `secure_aggregation` it is required and must be at most 10.

update_digest.title: Update Digest
update_digest.description: The digest the update channel returned for the site's update. Stored; no planner rule reads it.

metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.description: Named measurements the site reports, such as `accuracy`.

local_evidence_pointer.title: Local Evidence Pointer
local_evidence_pointer.description: Where the site keeps its detailed evidence. Stored; the GMA never follows it.

SiteResult.title: SiteResult
SiteResult.description:
What one site returns from a round.

Deliberately minimal. No subject identifier, row, image, note, or
per-subject prediction has a place in this contract; detailed local
evidence stays at the site behind ``local_evidence_pointer``.

A model update is not carried here either. Results are stored with the
round and shown to the coordinator, so a site that trains sends its clipped
update through an update channel and reports only its norm
(``update_norm``) and the digest the channel returned (``update_digest``).
The runtime that aggregates checks each update against that digest.

batch_size.title: Batch Size
batch_size.description: The number of records in each batch. At least 1.

max_records.title: Max Records
max_records.description: The most records to read; the rest are dropped. A Postgres table query also gets it as `LIMIT`. Empty reads every record.

SourceBatching.title: SourceBatching
SourceBatching.description: How a source's records are split into batches when it is read.

valid.title: Valid
valid.description: True when the adapter found no errors. Warnings do not make a source invalid.

errors.title: Errors
errors.description: Problems that stop the source from being read, such as a role name that is not a valid identifier.

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.description: Problems that do not make the source invalid, such as an inline source with no records yet, or no connection settings to read through.

SourceValidationResult.title: SourceValidationResult
SourceValidationResult.description: What a source's adapter found when it checked the stored definition.

ingestion_id.title: Ingestion Id
ingestion_id.description: `telemetry-<n>`, where n counts the envelopes this GMA has received since it started, from 1.

TelemetryAck.title: TelemetryAck
TelemetryAck.description: The GMA's receipt for one telemetry envelope.

agent.description: The agent that sent the telemetry.

pointers.title: Pointers
pointers.description: References to evidence kept elsewhere, such as the run's scope and the bundle's address.

TelemetryEnvelope.title: TelemetryEnvelope
TelemetryEnvelope.description: The telemetry one run or one agent sends: who sent it, the values, and pointers to the evidence.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Labels that say what the value is about, such as `bundle_id`.

observed_at.title: Observed At
observed_at.description: When the value was measured, in Unix seconds.

agent_id.title: Agent Id
agent_id.description: The agent that sent the envelopes.

metric_points.title: Metric Points
metric_points.description: How many values those envelopes held.

latest_observed_at.title: Latest Observed At
latest_observed_at.description: The latest `observed_at` among the values. Null when the envelopes held none.

metric_totals.title: Metric Totals
metric_totals.description: Each metric key, with the sum of its values.

TelemetrySummary.title: TelemetrySummary
TelemetrySummary.description: The telemetry one agent has sent, added up.

services.name: healthcare-demo-backend
services.title: dagents-healthcare-stroke-demo
services.description: A Dagents demo app for federated stroke triage, on de-identified records from the International Stroke Trial. Nothing here is a validated clinical model or clinical advice.

endpoints.summary: The consortium charts, from site summaries and the last pilot. Never a 4xx.

schema.title: Response Consortium Charts Api V1 Charts Get

responses.description: Only with a database: a hospital's store cannot be reached, or the database is not set up for this version of the app.

endpoints.summary: One consortium chart as SVG. 404 for a chart that needs a pilot that has not run.

parameters.name: chart_id
parameters.description: The chart's id, as `GET /api/v1/charts` lists it, such as `hospital-records`.

schema.description: The chart's id, as `GET /api/v1/charts` lists it, such as `hospital-records`.
schema.title: Chart Id

parameters.name: theme
parameters.description: The colours to draw the chart in: `light` or `dark`. The data is the same.

schema.description: The colours to draw the chart in: `light` or `dark`. The data is the same.
schema.title: Theme

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: The `ETag` of a copy you hold. If the chart has not changed, the answer is 304 with no body.

responses.description: The chart, as an SVG document.
The chart has not changed since the ETag sent in If-None-Match. No body.
No chart has this id, or the chart needs a pilot that has not run yet.
A parameter or a body field is not valid. The errors field names each one.
